seoTitle: OSS VAT Calculator for EU Distance Sales
metaDescription: Work out VAT due per EU destination country for B2C distance sales at standard rates, with totals for your One-Stop-Shop return.
intro: VAT per destination country and the total for an OSS return.
why:
Under the One-Stop-Shop scheme you charge the VAT rate of the customer's country and report it in one return. Doing that by hand across countries is error-prone.

Paste country and amount lines. The tool uses standard rates from the bundled table, or a rate you give per line, and works from net or gross amounts. It does not file anything.
howTo: Paste lines of country code and amount, with an optional rate.
Choose net or gross amounts and enter your own country.
Read VAT per country and the total.

faq.a: Standard rates as of 13 July 2026 from the Your Europe page, unless you override them.

faq.q: Why are my own country sales rejected?
faq.a: Domestic sales go on your normal VAT return, not OSS.
No. Enter amounts in the reporting currency.
